name: core
comment: Core: connection, dispatch, reconnect, protocol profile, cert helpers. Measured 78.4/66.1/86.6 on unit+conformance.

name: features
comment: Feature clients: telemetry, twin, direct method, c2d, file upload, adu. Measured 68.6/54.6/87.7 on unit+conformance.

name: adapter-paho
comment: Shipped (AZ_IOT_WITH_PAHO default ON). Coverage comes almost entirely from the broker-gated conformance suites, not from unit tests. Measured 65.1/41.8/81.6 on unit+conformance; the lowest floors in the file because a broker outage moves this component further than any other.

name: adapter-adu-crypto
comment: Shipped (AZ_IOT_WITH_ADU_CRYPTO_OPENSSL default ON, requires OpenSSL 3.0+). Measured 78.9/46.5/100.0 on unit+conformance; the e2e suites add nothing here, so the nightly figure is identical.

name: adapter-cert-managed
comment: Shipped (AZ_IOT_WITH_CERT_PROVIDER_MANAGED default ON, requires OpenSSL 3.0+). Measured 78.2/57.9/84.6 on unit+conformance.
